fields.name: duration
fields.title: Duration
fields.description: The duration of the generated video in seconds

fields.name: generate_audio
fields.title: Generate Audio
fields.description: Whether to generate native audio for the video. Supports Chinese and English voice output. Other languages are automatically translated to English. For English speech, use lowercase letters; for acronyms or proper nouns, use uppercase.

fields.name: shot_type
fields.title: Shot Type
fields.description: The type of multi-shot video generation. 'intelligent' lets the model automatically determine shot structure.

fields.name: cfg_scale
fields.title: Cfg Scale
fields.description:
The CFG (Classifier Free Guidance) scale is a measure of how close you want
            the model to stick to your prompt.
